source_observation.finding: the engine opened the current workspace episode but invoked inference.reason(world, content) without inserting that fresh workspace into world
source_observation.consequence: workspace existence and later selection could coexist with an inference call that never received the current workspace; this is a source-level causal disconnect for compiled-external workspace conditioning

mechanism: compile current workspace into bounded workspace_control before inference
bind episode_id, turn_id, session generation, salience and offered alternatives
compute SHA-256 control_digest over canonical control material
supply workspace_control inside world to the inference adapter
regression asserts exact episode/turn/generation/alternatives/authority flags and digest recomputation

evidence.workflow_interpretation: execution admission/control-plane failure before visible steps; not test failure and not runtime evidence

next_discriminator.instruction: on an admitted exact runtime, hold observation, evidence, model and adapter fixed; perturb only the admitted workspace_control; cross-bind the exact control digest to the inference packet and compare downstream candidate behavior; report MEASURED_SUPPORTED, REFUTED or UNKNOWN rather than inferring causality from receipt presence
next_discriminator.promotion_rule: workspace receipt or digest presence alone must never count as causal-use evidence
